The anchor netlist uses a two-stage tuned common-source topology with LC interstage coupling, but it lacks additional impedance control and feedback mechanisms that could stabilize the system over a broader frequency range.

To address this, I added a feedback path from the output to the input through a resistor (ZR2) and a capacitor (ZC2), which helps stabilize the circuit by introducing controlled negative feedback. Additionally, I added a resistor (ZR1) and capacitor (ZC1) between the interstage nodes to provide impedance matching and further stabilize the circuit. These changes help improve the phase margin and bandwidth, ensuring that the stability factor (mu) remains above the required threshold across the entire 0.01–50 GHz range.
